_: Single source of truth for every channel made in this repo. Rename a channel here (name/handle) and the on-screen tag, covers and posting kits follow. `id` never changes: it is what episode.json refers to. A series is a channel: an episode picks it with `channel` (or the older `seriesId`/`series`); default is redrawn. Optional per-channel defaults: `voice` (used when episode.json has none), `music` (style of pipeline/music.sh), `brand` (variant of the series bar), `post` (posting-kit texts).
